channel.title: Sea Technology magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Sea Technology magazine (sea-technology.com)

item.title: High-Resolution Sub-Bottom Survey Reveals Hidden Histories in Sicily
item.description: Genautics' Alfonso R. Analfino and Giuseppe Decaro and GeoAcoustics' Francisco J. Gutiérrez detail an archeological survey of Porto Empedocle, Sicily. The post High-Resolution Sub-Bottom Survey Reveals Hidden Histories in Sicily appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: Marine Software Developer to Scale AI-Driven Fuel Saving Platform
item.description: Swedish AI company Cetasol has raised $2.7m in a seed funding round to scale its AI-driven decision support and digital twin technology to reduce fuel use for ships. The post Marine Software Developer to Scale AI-Driven Fuel Saving Platform appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: Optical Sensors for Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement Research Pilot
item.description: Kirby Simon of Sequoia Scientific, Dr. Dariia Atamanchuk of Dalhousie University and Dr. Will Burt of Planetary Tech discuss the role of optical sensors for an ocean alkalinity enhancement research pilot in Halifax, Canada. The post Optical Sensors for Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement Research Pilot appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: Moving Vessel Profiler for Science
item.description: Georgia Haydock of AML Oceanographic introduces an MVP designed for collecting high-density water column profiles continuously in real time, making it ideal for scientific applications. The post Moving Vessel Profiler for Science appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: World’s First Full-Scale CCS Deployment on a Seagoing Vessel
item.description: Sigurd Jenssen of Wärtsilä Marine introduces onboard carbon capture and storage technology aboard Solvang ASA’s ethylene carrier Clipper Eris, designed to capture more than 70 percent of carbon dioxide from all onboard combustion sources. The post World’s First Full-Scale CCS Deployment on a Seagoing Vessel appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: How Hydrogen Technology Supports the Energy Transition
item.description: Richard Colwill, Alexander Tancock and Warner Priest of InterContinental Energy describe the P2(H2)Node solution that offers a global, scalable, cost-efficient model for providing green molecules to the marine sector. The post How Hydrogen Technology Supports the Energy Transition appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: Treasures, Shipwrecks and the Dawn of Red Sea Diving
item.description: Howard Rosenstein recounts his days of pioneering diving operations in the Red Sea. The post Treasures, Shipwrecks and the Dawn of Red Sea Diving appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: Case Study: Coral Bleaching in Mauritius
item.description: Dr. Anusha Devi Nawoor and Dr. Nora von Xylander of Tunley Environmental present a case study of coral bleaching in Mauritius, arguing that without addressing root causes, the survival of coral reefs worldwide remains at serious risk. The post Case Study: Coral Bleaching in Mauritius appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: Farewell from Sea Technology
item.description: Sea Technology will cease publication permanently. The post Farewell from Sea Technology appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.

item.title: Vietnam Marine & Offshore Expo, Nov. 19-21
item.description: VIMOX 2025 will also feature a collaboration with Offshore Wind Vietnam Expo to drive innovation, foster business connections and promote the future of sustainable maritime technologies. The post Vietnam Marine & Offshore Expo, Nov. 19-21 appeared first on Sea Technology magazine.
